digest.component_or_area: plan review gate evaluation / research measurement
propositions: Deterministic seeded-defect mutant corpus, thresholds, and counting helpers were designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally not landed on main because the harness exists only to drive a rejected LLM batch.
The ~100-run live LLM batch baseline that would measure gate detection and blocking-FP rates against the mutant corpus is permanently rejected on cost grounds.

The live batch is superseded by story d8a5 (change #798, MERGED) standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder, which accumulates the same detection/blocking-FP signal from real production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.

Five defect classes are mechanically seeded into real cleanly-closed plans: absent asserted capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, and untagged operational AC.
Store isolation is implemented by construction via standalone git clone with own .git directory, preventing mutation commits from contaminating the real tracker.
Run-validity guard (≥0.20 INDETERMINATE cap) and pure counting helpers (classify_pair, run_validity) are built, unit-tested offline, and do not depend on LLM evaluation.
